suggestTravel: Can I travel outside Poland while I wait for my decision?
suggestStatus: Explain my case status in simple words
intro: I know your case: letters, dates, documents and what was said at the counter. I explain and prepare. I never file or log in for you.
fine: Dossierly explains and organises. It isn’t legal advice.
errOffline: You seem to be offline. Check your connection and retry.
errBudget: Today’s usage limit is reached. Try again tomorrow.
errBusy: Lots of requests just now. Wait a few seconds and retry.
errPaused: Dossierly’s model is paused right now. Try again shortly.
ccTitle: What would you like to understand?
ccIntro: Your reviewed case information provides context. Dossierly offers guidance; it does not fill, sign or submit applications.
ccPlaceholder: For example, which documents should I check against this letter?
ccBring: Bring a question from another chat
ccPasteNote: Paste the text you want to use. Review it below before sending. Shared-chat links are treated as text and are never opened or imported.
ccNoLetters: No reviewed letters are attached to this case yet. {link} when you have one.
ccContextLetter: Context: your case profile, recorded events and “{title}”.
ccContextChecklist: Context: your case profile, recorded events and document checklist.
ccUnverified: Other-chat text is unverified context. Check names, dates and assumptions. Only this question and your selected case context are sent for an answer.
ccSaveFail: This conversation could not be saved on this device. Keep this tab open and retry.
ccInterrupted: The request was interrupted before its receipt arrived. Retry explicitly if you still need an answer.
ccOpenFail: Your saved conversation could not be opened.
ccUnsafe: The answer could not be opened safely. Retry this question.
ccTooLong: Write a question of up to 1,500 characters.
ccStoppedNote: Stopped. A request already sent to the provider may still count toward usage.
